title: Capital Plan, Retirement of Borrower Equity on Loan Payoff — Member Equities & Patronage
content:
Member Equities & Patronage borrower equity (a class retired on loan payoff) is retired at par once the member has no loan left in an open status.

## Provisions

(a) **No open loan anywhere.** Borrower equity may be retired on payoff only when the member has no loan in an open status in any product line (the count of the member's open loans is 0). The test reads the status of every loan the member holds across all product lines, from the association's records, before the retirement is made, for the member who owns the holding.

(b) **Timing and payment.** The retirement is made within the class's retirement processing period in calendar days after the closed date of the member's last open loan (the latest closed date among the member's loans once none remains in an open status), by the holding's payment method (a holding set to apply cash to a loan is paid by check), recorded with the reason loan payoff, and the holding is then closed.

(c) **While any loan is open.** While any loan remains open, even one in a different product line, nothing is retired, and a member who pays off one of several loans keeps the whole borrower equity.

(d) **Allocated surplus.** Allocated surplus is never retired on payoff; it waits for revolvement or estate retirement.

(e) **Board discretion.** Retirement remains at the board's discretion and is suspended for every member while the board has suspended retirements to protect capital.

## Open status, by product line

- Operating Lines of Credit: applied, active, suspended or matured;
- Equipment & Vehicle Loans: applied, active, deferred or nonaccrual;
- Farm Real Estate Loans: applied, active or nonaccrual;
- Rural Home Loans (the Country Home loans): applied, active, forbearance or nonaccrual;
- Construction Loans: applied, active, extended or converting.

## Hypothetical cases (borrower equity classes: retired on payoff, 60 calendar days)

| Member's loans | Borrower equity |
|---|---|
| Farm real estate loan paid off and closed on 10 April 2026; an equipment loan still active | Nothing retired; the whole balance stays |
| Last loan, a Country Home loan, closed on 10 April 2026; no other loan in an open status | Retired at par by check or direct deposit, with the reason loan payoff, no later than 9 June 2026 (60 calendar days after 10 April 2026); the holding is closed |
| Last loan closed; holding set to apply cash to a loan | Paid by check |
